title: Rory and the Cozy Dewdrop Cove
verses:
The evening was quiet and cool in the cove,
As darkness came down from the sky,
Then Rory sat down on a blanket of moss,
And watched as the shadows went by.

Then Nia flew down through the cool evening air,
To join with her friends on the ground,
While Benny lay back on a pillow of leaves,
Without making one single sound.

High up in a branch sat Psittaco in peace,
Tucked into a nest warm and deep,
And Ricky stopped running to rest in the shade,
Preparing to drift off to sleep.

Then Tilly curled up by the bank of the stream,
Where water was shining like gold,
She smiled at the moon as it brightened the night,
With stories of sleep to be told.

A breeze whispered softly through branches above,
To blow all their worries away,
And Rory sighed happily under the stars,
At end of a wonderful day.

The forest was silent and cozy and calm,
As bedtime was finally here,
So Rory closed eyes with a restful deep breath,
Surrounded by those he held dear.
